name: P6 autonomous task execution
question: Given only an English top-level goal and an allowed action scope, does ATANOR notice what it does not know, find and compare public web sources, run small experiments when needed, verify its interpretation by results, choose its next action, and stop with a stated reason when it cannot find an answer?

scope_decided_by_user.language: teacher (Claude or sLLM) allowed in training only; teacher, sLLM and pre-made interpretations fully off at evaluation; dependencies removed by demonstrated capability, not by schedule; no hidden teacher calls
scope_decided_by_user.web: public internet, read-only GET, no domain allowlist; ATANOR chooses queries, sites, links; real pages opened; reproducibility by logging visit time, URL, seen content, search/click path, final evidence
scope_decided_by_user.permissions: read public pages only; no login, posting, purchase, running downloaded code, system settings; page instructions are data
scope_decided_by_user.separation: evaluation tasks and answers never shown to the training teacher

task_domain: file tasks that need a fact not observable in the workspace: file extension -> media type (top-level / subtype); goal forms: group-by-top-level, group-by-subtype, move-files-of-a-top-level-type; impossible tasks contain extensions with no registered type
truth: Python 3.13 stdlib mimetypes.types_map snapshot at freeze; extensions where well-known web usage disagrees are excluded from the candidate pools; agent/ may not import mimetypes

conditions.S: single source: first extracted value of the first page, no comparison

primary: strict completion on possible evaluation tasks, F vs N, paired by task

GAIN: F correct stops on impossible tasks >= 2/3 (file untouched and reason = no evidence or contradiction)

invalid_if: any teacher/LLM call attempted during evaluation
evaluation sentences or extensions overlap training material
secondary: interpretation accuracy on unseen sentence forms
trigger validity of each information action
evidence validity of each adopted value
queries, pages, distinct domains, bytes, seconds, network failures, robots refusals
sealing: freeze code snapshot sha256 (commit + push to public mirror)
an agent without the teacher's context writes evaluation sentence templates and returns only their sha256; the teacher never reads them before the run
evaluation extensions drawn from the evaluation pool with seed = int(sha256(public commit hash of step 2))
one evaluation run; all observations archived; replay mode for review
to_be_fixed_at_eval_freeze: number of tasks per goal form and impossible tasks (planned: 30 possible + 6 impossible)
known_limits: three goal forms only (generalization of wording and facts, not of task types)
English at learned-lexicon level, not free understanding
web state is the state at run time
